Volcanoes, water and expedition sites

This page covers the volcanic ground, the kinds of water you will find, and how to reach and collect the three expedition sites in a new world.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 3 min read · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides
Contents
  1. Volcanoes and volcanic ground
  2. Lakes, rivers and wetlands
  3. Expedition sites
  4. How this was checked

Volcanoes and volcanic ground

Some islands have a volcano. Each one has one of three shapes. Volcanoes and volcanic terrain

  • Shield volcano: a broad, low mountain.
  • Stratovolcano: a steeper cone.
  • Breached caldera: a summit crater with one side broken open. These are older and more worn down.

Older volcanoes are more eroded and more overgrown. Volcanic ground is made of basalt, obsidian, volcanic ash, lava rock, pahoehoe stone and magma stone.

Magma stone glows, but it does not heat you or set anything on fire. Steam vents and warm or boiling pools are found in the geothermal ground beside the volcanoes.

Good to know. There is no molten lava and nothing burns. Steam vents are plain blocks: they do not make steam clouds. Flowing lava and fire are not in the game yet.

Lakes, rivers and wetlands

Islands have river channels, inland lakes, marshes, bogs, mangroves, bayous and frozen lakes. Inland lakes sit no higher than 62 m above sea level. Rivers, lakes and wetlands

Natural water stays still. Rivers do not flow and do not push you. Water you place or dig out does flow.

The kind of water depends on where it is:

  • Ocean: Water.
  • Lakes and rivers: Fresh water.
  • Warm wetlands (marshes, bogs, mangroves and bayous): Black water.
  • Hot springs and geothermal ground: Hot spring water. The hottest pools are Boiling water.
  • Frozen lakes: Ice or Black ice. Frozen sea: Ice, Black ice or Glacier ice.
Good to know. Boiling water and steam do not hurt you in this version.

Expedition sites

Worlds made in the current generation (generation 10) have three small expedition sites near spawn. Each site is somewhere inside a square about 240 m wide. The three squares are centred about 215 m, 340 m and 440 m from spawn. The site ground must be dry and level. Expedition sites and one-time supply finds

Good to know. Older worlds have no expedition sites. If the game cannot find a dry, level spot in a square, that site is missing.
  1. Press E, then Tab to the Journal. The three sites are listed. A '?' means you have not found it yet, and a '+' means you have.
  2. Click a site name to make it your destination. A beacon and an on-screen marker show the way.
  3. Walk on the ground to within 12 m of the site. The status line says 'Discovered' and the site name.
  4. Stay within 12 m, open the Journal and click Find next to the site. You must be on foot, not flying, sailing or riding.
  5. Check that you have pack space. If you do not, the game says the find will wait there, so free some space and try again.
  • Survey workshop: 16 Alder boards and 8 Glass.
  • Reed refuge: 16 Reeds.
  • Stone overlook: 8 Chalk and 8 Basalt.

After you collect a find, its button reads Taken. Use Craft to turn the materials into buildings.

Careful. Each find can be collected only once, and the game saves that it was taken. Collect it before your pack is full; a find that does not fit waits at the site.

How this guide was checked

Volcano shapes and ages come from crates/voxelgame-core/src/world/generator/relief.rs at Voxelgame 0494a0ce (volcano_plan, lines 172-195). Surface water kinds come from crates/voxelgame-core/src/world/generator.rs at the same commit (surface water material, lines 3666-3690), and the inland lake limit from MAX_INLAND_LAKE_LEVEL (sea level + 62 m, line 54). Block names come from crates/voxelgame-core/src/world/block/table.rs. Expedition placement, discovery, collection and find contents come from crates/voxelgame-core/src/game/exploration.rs in the same commit; the Journal labels come from crates/voxelgame-render/src/inventory_ui.rs.

Voxelgame main dd29d91, committed 10 October 2026; guide written 12 October 2026. Source-checked, not play-tested in this guide. A site is skipped when its square has no dry, level spot, so some new worlds may have fewer than three. The site squares are the code's rule; the exact site is somewhere inside its square. Source HEAD has moved past this pin, so the values here are from 0494a0ce.
